name: fqc-jira
description: Jira access for FQC-ARR via Atlassian REST (token auth) — never the Atlassian MCP. Reads are silent; writes (comment/transition/attachment) carry destructiveHint so Sana raises a Tasks-inbox approval card before posting.

securityScheme.note: Sana holds Atlassian creds and mirrors the invoking user. Fallback local: JIRA_EMAIL + JIRA_API_TOKEN Basic auth against JIRA_BASE_URL.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Fetch an issue with selected fields (summary/status/assignee/reporter/issuetype/labels/components/description/comment). Read-only.

tools.name: search
tools.description: JQL search returning matching issues. Read-only.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Post an ADF comment to an issue. GATED — requires human approval (destructiveHint). Body must be identifier-first with no agent self-signature.

tools.name: add_attachment
tools.description: Attach a file (e.g. the FQC-ARR run report) to an issue. GATED (destructiveHint).

tools.name: transition
tools.description: Transition an issue to a new status by transition id. GATED (destructiveHint). Never auto-transition to Done — QA owns acceptance.
